interpretation: This compares one fixed, completed PhysX-trained beta-OFF policy in two native validation plants, NOT beta-ON versus beta-OFF and NOT two training origins.
Both engines lose balance and accumulate substantial XY error. Therefore this actor's failure is not solely a sim2sim-transfer failure.
Core XY RMSE is PhysX .374 versus MuJoCo .148 m. Full real-reference overlap XY RMSE is 1.323 versus .738 m; core-only reporting hides the late MuJoCo failure.
Persistent tilt>=30deg onset is PhysX 2.92 versus MuJoCo 4.01 s, confirmed 3.02 versus 4.11 s. This is a diagnostic, not an added failure gate.
No height, airborne, tilt or contact termination is introduced. Native full records remain visible through6.98s; real reference ends6.96s.
The t=0 force/torque readout is a pre-action initialization snapshot, not evidence of an actual first-step collision or commanded torque mismatch.
Native contact laws, inertia/frame representations and force/count telemetry operators differ; matching nominal effective mu and initial observable states does not make the plants equivalent.
The two runs use the same policy, not an imposed identical action replay: feedback observations/actions diverge with native plant trajectories.
MuJoCo validation here is native CPU MuJoCo, not MJWarp or Newton. N=1 per engine is descriptive, not a statistical engine ranking.
